summary: This file contains only a static data dictionary (KHOT_EMBEDDINGS) with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It provides pre-computed k-hot elemental embeddings (96-dimensional binary vectors) indexed by atomic number 1-100 for use in CGCNN-style graph neural networks. No example statements are included because there is no executable code to invoke.
KHOT_EMBEDDINGS: a static dictionary mapping atomic numbers (1-100) to 96-dimensional k-hot binary vectors representing elemental properties for CGCNN graph neural network embeddings
